additional_info.subject: AW: ID0392001-DC/Si-D/DE[170003340] - ELMS configuration CRM:00315002107
additional_info.body:
Hello.
Before I respond to your questions, some Info.
I program the ELSM using a Siemens PLC 1500.This program and the communication with SichargeD has worked properly at least 14 times.
Now to your questions.
The IP Address 192.168.1.20 has not a conflict with other Devices in network. Port is OK
If your config is Ok, then we need to take other approach to our problem.
Normally and during the commissioning is someone from SiD on site with us and we check together if the communication cable is OK and put in the right connector.
Sadly, this time no one from SiD was on Site and I myself am not allowed to open the Sid cabinet to do a check. In this case I program mi EMLS and the people from SiD do the rest (Addressing and release from EMLS). As far the communication is OK, then everything goes automatic.
We had the same problem in our last project (Bremen) and the support found out the cable was connected in the wrong port. They sent someone from yunextraffic to check this out. We worked together online and then everything ran OK. Maybe this time the same is happening.
Please confirm to me, which steps we take now and if you have some questions, please let me know about this.
With best regards,
Jose Emilio Cortes Pastrana
